- [Can you use cucumber (kheera) with glutathione cream?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-with-cucumber/): Yes, as a separate step: dab fresh cucumber juice or lay thin slices on clean skin for about 10 minutes, rinse with plain water, pat dry, then apply the glutathione cream, with sunscreen every morning. Never mix cucumber juice into the jar.
- [Can you use castor oil (arandi ka tel) with glutathione cream?](https://www.fairnpink.in/journal/glutathione-cream-with-castor-oil/): Yes, sparingly: apply the glutathione cream first, wait a few minutes, then press one drop of castor oil only on dry areas at night, with sunscreen every morning. Castor oil is very thick, so oily or acne-prone skin should usually skip it, and never mix it into the jar.
